body:
User asked (verbatim): "5. Optional P3/P4 features. … then build all" (LC-16 dry-run maintenance includes SweepAbandoned).

Context: MAINTENANCE built dry-run for SweepTrash, SweepOrphans, UploadSweep and SweepRetention. Disk.SweepAbandoned has none, because drivers only report abandoned work by removing it. A preview needs a new optional driver interface (AbandonedFinder plus a capability bit in driver.go) implemented in memory, local, s3, azure, sftp, ftp, webdav and crypt. Deferred 2026-10-07 so MAINTENANCE does not touch eight adapters; a dry-run schedule for it is refused for now.

Acceptance: AbandonedFinder declared and implemented by every driver that sweeps; Disk.FindAbandoned; jobs SweepAbandoned honours DryRun; conformance case.
title: Dry-run for Disk.SweepAbandoned (AbandonedFinder driver interface)
